response.justification: Bogdan brings 15+ years of hands-on engineering breadth (backend, low-latency microservices at Sociomantic, fintech-adjacent work at RIDE Capital, and early agentic/MCP tooling at re:cinq), but the profile is that of a senior/staff individual contributor, not an executive. The role's hard requirements — 5+ years of senior technical leadership, scaling teams from 10 to 30+, developing a leadership layer, governing outsourced delivery partners, and board-level communication — are essentially unevidenced; titles are consistently IC-track (Senior/Staff Software Developer), with founder of a small open-source project as the only leadership signal. Equally critical, there is no demonstrated production multi-agent AI system with shared memory, feedback loops, evaluation infrastructure, or model-agnostic orchestration — only contributions to agent tooling. Deep distributed-systems credibility and some regulated-finance exposure are genuine positives, but the gap to CTO of a venture-backed fintech scale-up is too large to bridge in this search.
strengths: Deep distributed-systems and low-latency backend experience (millions of HTTP req/s at Sociomantic)
Relevant domain exposure: RIDE Capital fintech plus current AI-agent/MCP infrastructure work
Strong engineering-craft culture: TDD, CI/CD, DevOps, open-source tooling, teaching and public speaking
concerns: No executive or people-management track record; no evidence of scaling teams to 30+
Agentic AI experience is tooling/contributory, not architecting production multi-agent systems
No experience with outsourced-delivery governance, board reporting, or regulated AI compliance

key_factors.factor: Absence of senior leadership / team-scaling record
No production multi-agent AI system ownership
Strong distributed-systems and low-latency backend depth
